# scphasedcn

Single-cell copy-number calling for **SPLONGGET**: single-cell long-read
DNA sequencing in which every read carries a 10x Multiome cell barcode
and is sequenced on Oxford Nanopore. scphasedcn combines read depth with
read-phased alleles (each molecule covering a phased heterozygous SNP
votes for a haplotype), per cell and region:

- **normal tissue**: rare, cell-private gains, losses and copy-neutral
  LOH, with thresholds calibrated on null cells (1 false call per 1,000
  null cell-regions), per cell and in cell pools;
- **tumours**: clone discovery, allele-specific clone copy-number
  profiles, likelihood assignment of every cell, per-cell inherited /
  confirmed calls, and input for MEDICC2 trees.

The repository holds two packages, both named scphasedcn, that are used
together:

| package | language | does |
|----|----|----|
| `scphasedcn` (Python, `python/`) | Python (pysam) | BAM -\> extraction directory: per-cell 100 kb bin counts, a fragment table with haplotypes, cell QC |
| `scphasedcn` (R, root) | R | extraction directory -\> calls, clones, tables |

## Install

Container (Docker / Apptainer / Singularity; R, Python, both packages
and htslib):

``` bash
apptainer pull docker://ghcr.io/ljwharbers/scphasedcn:0.1.1
apptainer exec scphasedcn_0.1.1.sif scphasedcn --help
```

Conda (from a checkout):

``` bash
git clone https://github.com/ljwharbers/scphasedcn && cd scphasedcn
conda env create -f environment.yml && conda activate scphasedcn      # or micromamba
pip install ./python && R CMD INSTALL .
bash tools/smoke_test.sh                                            # end-to-end check on simulated data
```

To reproduce results exactly, use the container of the release: per-cell
calls are identical across installations, but the chromatin-kNN pooled
calls depend slightly on the BLAS and `irlba` versions.

From source into existing installations: `pip install ./python` (Python
\>= 3.10) and, in R (\>= 4.2),
`install.packages("pak"); pak::pak("ljwharbers/scphasedcn")`
(Bioconductor dependencies: rhdf5, Rsamtools). A `tabix` on the PATH
speeds up reading the fragment table.

## Quick start

``` bash
# 1. phased heterozygous SNPs (Clair3 + longphase on the pooled BAM; see vignette("scphasedcn-inputs"))
scphasedcn select-hets --vcf sample.longphase.vcf.gz --loci 1000G_snvs_hg38.vcf.gz --out het_phased.vcf.gz
#    normal tissue (recommended): join the blocks into chromosome-wide haplotypes with a population phase of the sample
#    (e.g. Beagle 5 + 1000 Genomes panel, one VCF per chromosome), then extract with het_hybrid.vcf.gz
scphasedcn hybrid-phase --blocks het_phased.vcf.gz --population 'popphased_{chrom}.vcf.gz' --out het_hybrid.vcf.gz

# 2. extraction (all chromosomes in parallel, then merge; tumour mode: --snps het_phased.vcf.gz)
scphasedcn run --bam sample.bam --barcodes barcodes.tsv.gz --fasta GRCh38.fa \
    --snps het_hybrid.vcf.gz --phased --out results/sample/extract --jobs 8

# 3. calling
CALL=$(Rscript -e 'cat(system.file("scripts", "call_scn.R", package = "scphasedcn"))')   # in the container: call_scn.R
Rscript $CALL --dir results/sample/extract --out results/sample/caller --sex female --mode normal --null-cells select
```

or in R:

``` r

library(scphasedcn)
res = call_scn("results/sample/extract", mode = "tumour", sex = "male")
write_scphasedcn(res, "results/sample/caller")
```

Documentation: <https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/>, or in R
[`vignette("scphasedcn")`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/articles/scphasedcn.md)
(overview and a run on simulated data),
[`vignette("scphasedcn-inputs")`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/articles/scphasedcn-inputs.md)
(input requirements, phasing recipe, extraction, cell metadata),
[`vignette("scphasedcn-outputs")`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/articles/scphasedcn-outputs.md)
(result tables).

Scope: GRCh38 / hg38 with `chr` names; Linux and macOS.

## Citation

Please cite the SPLONGGET paper (reference to be added on publication)
and the package: `citation("scphasedcn")`.

## License

MIT (`LICENSE.md`). The bundled ENCODE blacklist (Amemiya et al. 2019)
and centromere coordinates (Battenberg) are credited in
`python/src/scphasedcn/resources/README.md`.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`allelic_features()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/allelic_features.md)
  : Allele features per cell and region

- [`allelic_noisy_tiles()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/allelic_noisy_tiles.md)
  : Allelically overdispersed tiles (data-driven allelic mask)

- [`annotate_arms()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/annotate_arms.md)
  : Chromosome arms and centromere flags from the Battenberg coordinate
  table

- [`apply_thresholds()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/apply_thresholds.md)
  : Apply null thresholds to scored rows

- [`arm_regions()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/arm_regions.md)
  : Arm regions from an annotated bins table

- [`arm_table()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/arm_table.md)
  : Chromosome arms (Battenberg coordinates)

- [`as_dgc()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/as_dgc.md)
  : Coerce to a bins x cells dgCMatrix

- [`assign_cells()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/assign_cells.md)
  : Assign cells to clones by their likelihood under the clone states

- [`assign_folds()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/assign_folds.md)
  : Cross-validation folds of cells

- [`assign_hstratum()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/assign_hstratum.md)
  : Vote stratum of each row

- [`atoms_from_regions()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/atoms_from_regions.md)
  : Allele atoms

- [`atoms_in_tiles()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/atoms_in_tiles.md)
  : Atoms whose start lies in the masked tiles

- [`bb_loglik()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/bb_loglik.md)
  : Beta-binomial log-likelihood

- [`bin_filter()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/bin_filter.md)
  : Usable-bin flag

- [`budget_threshold()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/budget_threshold.md)
  : Threshold at a false-call budget from null scores

- [`budget_thresholds()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/budget_thresholds.md)
  : Null thresholds at the false-call budget

- [`build_layers_from_fragments()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/build_layers_from_fragments.md)
  : Build the bin-level layers from a fragment table

- [`call_policy()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/call_policy.md)
  : Calling policy: which class x state is called at which level

  : Pooled calls

- [`call_scn()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/call_scn.md)
  : Single-cell copy-number calls of a sample

  : Per-cell calls table

- [`caller_defaults()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/caller_defaults.md)
  : Default parameters of the copy-number caller

  : Normal-tissue copy-number caller

  : Caller parameters from the caller config

  Per-row rho from a
  [`rho_by_chrom()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/rho_by_chrom.md)

  : Robust overdispersion of null allele votes

- [`scn_embedding()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/scn_embedding.md)
  : Chromatin embedding of the cells of a sample

- [`score_cells()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/score_cells.md)
  : Per-state log-likelihood ratios and scores per cell x region

  : Headline numbers of a caller result

  : sd_class of a region (which null regions give its per-cell null SD)

  : Segment clone profiles (Viterbi)

  : Pieces: the union of all clone segment breakpoints

- [`select_null_cells()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/select_null_cells.md)
  : Self-calibrated null cell set (normal tissue)

  : Default clonal tumour events for the simulator

  : Mini genome for simulations

- [`simulate_scn()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/simulate_scn.md)
  : Simulate a SPLONGGET-like single-nucleus DNA data set

- [`split_alt_states()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/split_alt_states.md)
  : Alternative states of a clone segment for the disagreement split

- [`split_disagree()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/split_disagree.md)
  : Split clones whose cells disagree with the clone state on a segment

- [`split_votes()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/split_votes.md)
  : Split molecule votes into two independent halves

- [`split_win()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/split_win.md)
  : Split window depth into two independent halves

- [`subset_features()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/subset_features.md)
  : Subset a features object to a set of cells

- [`subset_scn()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/subset_scn.md)
  : Subset an scn object by cells and/or bins

- [`switch_attenuation()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/switch_attenuation.md)
  : Expected attenuation of the anchored imbalance by switch errors

- [`tile_name()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/tile_name.md)
  : Tile region name

- [`update_allelic_features()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/update_allelic_features.md)
  : Re-aggregate the allele features of a features object without some
  atoms

- [`vote_bins()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/vote_bins.md)
  : Vote strata: bins of the allele votes per class x depth stratum

- [`window_ids()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/window_ids.md)
  : Window id per bin for aggregation to a coarser grid

- [`window_matrices()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/window_matrices.md)
  : Window count matrices for clone pseudobulks

- [`window_table()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/window_table.md)
  : Windows table (coordinates per window id)

- [`write_alleles_h5ad()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/write_alleles_h5ad.md)
  :

  Write the allele counts as `alleles_dna.h5ad` (layers AD, DP; var =
  SNPs)

- [`write_bins_h5ad()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/write_bins_h5ad.md)
  :

  Write an scn object as `bins_100kb.h5ad` (anndata layout, gzip only)

- [`write_fragments()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/write_fragments.md)
  : Write a fragments table as bgzipped TSV with a tabix index

- [`write_scphasedcn()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/write_scphasedcn.md)
  : Write a caller result to a directory

- [`write_sim_dataset()`](https://ljwharbers.github.io/scphasedcn/reference/write_sim_dataset.md)
  : Write a simulated data set in the extraction-layer layout
